calibration.method: temperature scaling, score = sigmoid(logit(softmax P(scam)) / T), T minimises val log-loss
calibration.thresholds_rule: finetune.thresholds on the calibrated val scores; suspicious capped so val benign flags <= the app baseline's
calibration.suspicious_policy: not needed: MuRIL already flags fewer val benign messages than the baseline; the rule's cut-off is kept
calibration.meter_ends_rule: 1st / 99th percentile of the calibrated val scores
